target_customer: Consumers and athletes who want continuous eye based health and performance tracking from wearable smart glasses
problem: People track sleep and strain with wrist wearables, but the eyes are an untapped signal. STASIS pitches smart glasses that read eye signals as a WHOOP style tracker.
business_model: Consumer hardware, likely device sales with possible subscription (not confirmed by sources)
product_category: Eye tracking smart glasses for health and wellness

founders.name: Soham Chakraborty
founders.background_notes: Team Canada Speech and Debate per the YC page.

founders.name: Neil Goradia
previous_startups: GlaucoNova Labs (co-founded at age 18, hardware lead for non-invasive IOP monitoring; outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Co-author on 4 patents and IEEE published, per the YC page.

competitors.name: AdHawk Microsystems
competitors.what: MindLink research grade eye tracking glasses for cognition and eye health, MindLink Air for everyday use

competitors.name: Carolina Instruments
competitors.what: Camera free eye tracking smart glasses for mental health research, UNC spinout

competitors.name: Soma Reality
competitors.what: Vienna startup planning eye tracking glasses for cognitive state insights in 2027

technical_complexity.rationale: Custom eye sensing hardware in a wearable plus signal models that map eye data to health metrics, with no validated reference yet.

defensibility.rationale: Patents and hardware iteration help (CTO lists 4 patents), but large glasses makers and research rivals pursue eye tracking.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: An August 2026 report says Apple is pursuing health tracking for smart glasses, though not a focus of the first generation. No action against STASIS recorded.

market_need_then: Wearable health tracking is a large category (WHOOP raised 575 million USD in 2026 per press), and eye signals for fatigue and cognition are an active research area.

branding.domain_note: Launch site get-stasis.com redirects to wearstasis.com, so the exact name domain was not obtained.

identity.visual_style: Not retrievable; site text gave only a title
identity.voice_and_tone: Positioning by analogy: The WHOOP for 16 billion eyes; Smart glasses that listen to your eyes

branding.brand_signature: Tagline comparing the product to WHOOP

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found. Stasis is a common word and many trademarks and a hospital monitoring company named Stasis Labs exist.

outcome_analysis: STASIS is a two person Fall 2026 YC hardware company pitching eye based health tracking glasses. Founders have bioengineering and hardware backgrounds, but no funding, product traction or outcome information is public, so no success or failure story can be told yet.
notes: Funding search returned only Stasis Labs (a different Los Angeles hospital vitals company) and WHOOP, none about this company. Website content was only a title line. Confidence low because competition and funding are thin.
